_note: Curated from the Roblox KB (kbq.py num ...) on 2026-10-29. Bands are [lo, hi) in the metric unit. higher_is_better controls the verdict direction. flag follows the KB: official | indie | mixed | devforum | none. Review when _tools/BENCHMARKS.md changes; compare.py always prints the sources.

d1.label: D1 retention
bands: strong (at or above the 90th percentile for same-genre per an official talk)
d1.note: Official method: compare with your own Creator Hub Similar Experience Benchmarks (50th-90th percentile; DevForum example 12.4-24.1%). Genre changes the answer. About 6-8% was 'broken' for one indie live game.

d7.label: D7 retention
d7.note: Indie self-reported: 2-3% typical; one game at 1.45% expected about 4% once populated. The 2019 DevForum example 2.68% is historical. Prefer your Creator Hub similar-experience benchmark.

d30.label: D30 retention
d30.note: KB GAP: no numeric D30 benchmark. Official: low D30 means a missing endgame; compare with the Creator Hub similar-experience benchmark. RFY scores returns across D1, D2-7, D8-28.

session.label: Average session length
session.note: Bands are a DevForum author's rough scale (not hard data). Official talk: social games 10+ min; 15-20 min strong and 12 decent for large games; younger mobile about 8.5 min. Indie ad-phase target above 10 min. Average session = total time / number of sessions.

ptr.kb_check_comment: Rechecked 2026-10-29: bands kept. KB ad-campaign play-through (plays/impressions) is lower: 1-1.5% good, 2% very good (VuukStudios 2025-11 14:16, https://youtu.be/AbjI7ygMnao?t=856). Bands here are for in-experience PTR/QPTR, not ad PTR.
ptr.label: Play-through rate (PTR/QPTR)
ptr.note: 2026 official update: RFY uses PTR plus first-play bounce (QPTR removed); older QPTR advice is superseded where it conflicts. Compare against your Creator Hub numbers.

ctr.kb_check_comment: Rechecked 2026-10-29 with kbq.py num: bands kept. KB also holds a conflicting single-creator warning level, about 1.9% CTR means replace creative (janisjanis01 2026-05 9:19, https://youtu.be/BLOToGi2Qt4?t=559); treat 1.5-2.5 as at-risk.
ctr.label: Ad / thumbnail CTR
ctr.note: Self-reported by indie creators (kra_DeZ, MoseyTube). KB rule: below 1% replace the creative, target 2.5-3%+. CTR near 0.5% = packaging problem.

conv.label: Payer conversion
conv.note: Official talk sample: payer conversion 1.63%. Indie healthy 2-3% (self-reported). A pet-egg example went 0.3% to 0.75% after a teaser change. Genre and audience age change this a lot.

arppu.label: ARPPU
arppu.note: Only one KB data point: official talk sample ARPPU 573 Robux (April example). No band; use your Creator Hub similar-experience benchmark.

join.label: Median join time
join.note: Official 2018 talk: median about 5 s good; over 10 s not great. Join time = click play to world rendered and player can move (docs 2026-10).

fs5.label: First-session retention at 5 minutes
fs5.note: Single indie example (self-reported): 95% at 30 s, 87% at 1 min, 65% at 5 min; others 20-30%. Use the New User First Session Retention chart to find the steepest drop.

bounce.label: First-play bounce
bounce.note: KB GAP: no numeric benchmark. Official: leaving within 60 s or 61-180 s counts as negative. One indie game cut bounce from 22% to 15-16% by fixing a post-cutscene drop. Lower is better; compare with Creator Hub.

cpp.kb_check_comment: Rechecked 2026-10-29: bands kept. KB units differ across sources (62 Robux/play in 2023; 0.04 credits ~ 11 Robux, ~2c on a saturated game: Quez 2025-03 1:09); verify unit before comparing.
cpp.label: Ad cost per play
bands: at or better than indie day-one target
expensive: fix creative and CTR first
cpp.note: Indie target about $0.008 per play on day one (self-reported). Roblox claims as low as 1 cent cold start and under 1 cent per visit (2025). Median cost to acquire a highly engaged player under 50 cents (official 2026).

optin.label: Rewarded-video opt-in rate
optin.note: Official docs: opt-in 13%+/15%+, genre average 15-25%, best 30%+; frequency 2.5+/3+, best 4+ views per user per day.

fps.label: Client frame rate
fps.note: Default target 60 FPS (16.67 ms per frame); under 16 ms CPU per frame. Quest VR target 72 FPS.
